description.value: Walmart Supercenter in Powell River is a large-format department and grocery store serving the northern Sunshine Coast. For touring cyclists, it is one of the most comprehensive resupply options in the area, stocking groceries alongside clothing, electronics, and general merchandise. Powell River's semi-remote location on the Sunshine Coast — accessible only by ferry — makes a full-service store like this a notable landmark on longer touring routes.
